home.description: A focused collection of everyday web tools. Open a tool, process the input, copy the result, and keep one-off tasks in the browser.
home.aboutDescription: Turinhub Toolbox is an open source project for simple, efficient, ad-free online tools. Most tools run in the browser; AI, S3, FTP, or API testing tools may use browser network requests, server proxies, or third-party services. You can inspect the code on GitHub or deploy it locally.

tools.title: Online Tools
tools.description: Turinhub Toolbox collects free, ad-free, mostly local-first tools for development, text processing, design, networking, AI assistance, and everyday calculations.
